title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1982-02-20
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB/6th Row) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji FeCr Tape/Dolby DB)

ai_review.summary: Warm, audience‑sourced tape with crystal‑clear moments captures a high‑energy show highlighted by To Lay Me Down, Let It Grow and a soaring Franklin’s Tower opening.
ai_review.review: The performance bursts out of the gate and sustains its fire through two stellar sets, featuring standout renditions of To Lay Me Down, Let It Grow, Franklin’s Tower into Samson, and a memorable Playing‑in‑the‑Band jam.  The audience recording by Rango Keshavan is warm and slightly cloudy but remarkably clear, with Jerry front‑center and Brent’s keyboard solo cutting through the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: 13 reviews overwhelmingly 5‑star with only one 4 and one 0; consistent praise for both musical performance and tape quality yields a strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm, slightly cloudy texture but all instruments are discernible; Jerry is front‑center, Brent’s keys sit low in the mix; Miller transfer praised for fidelity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, classic‑heavy first set followed by an unusual Franklin’s opening to a tight second set; energy never wanes.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as playing like a god, front‑and‑center in the mix with superb tone.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted as less punchy due to equipment changes but still solid; overall good foundation.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent’s solo jam praised yet his keyboards sit low in the mix; early Yamaha electric piano tone mentioned.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drum work highlighted during the Playing‑in‑the‑Band jam and Brent solo transition.
